compagnie.treni: All Eurostar trains (routes to and from London, and routes between Belgium, France, the Netherlands and Germany)
compagnie.numero: 2 bags + 1 item of hand luggage (Eurostar Premier: 3 bags + 1)
compagnie.misure: Bags up to 85 cm long on London routes, 75 cm on other routes
compagnie.peso: No strict weight limit: you must be able to carry your bags yourself
compagnie.extra: London routes: book ahead, from £35 per extra bag (guide price); other routes: €30 per extra item on the day
compagnie.speciali: Pushchairs free if folded; skis and snowboards count as one of your two bags; dismantled bikes from £45 on London routes
compagnie.risposta: you can bring 2 bags and 1 item of hand luggage in Eurostar Standard and Eurostar Plus (3 bags and 1 item of hand luggage in Eurostar Premier); bags can be up to 85 cm long on routes to and from London and 75 cm on other routes, with no strict weight limit as long as you can carry them yourself.
compagnie.nota: The Eurostar Help Centre adds a size for routes between Belgium, France, the Netherlands and Germany (75x53x30 cm); the main luggage page gives only the length.

citazioni.x: With a standard ticket, you can bring: 2 x pieces of luggage. 1 x small item of hand luggage (like a handbag or backpack).
You can bring 2 bags and 1 piece of hand luggage in Eurostar Standard and Eurostar Plus, or 3 bags and 1 piece of hand luggage in Eurostar Premier.
Size limits depend on your route. On routes to and from London, you can bring a bag up to a maximum length of 85cm, and on all other routes, 75cm.
Unlike airlines, there's no strict weight limit per bag. If you can carry it safely yourself, you're good to go.
Up to two additional items (dimensions: 75x53x30cm max)

On our London routes, excess baggage, bikes and oversized items must be booked in advance through our Registered Luggage Service, which is currently limited to selected trains between London and Paris, as well as London and Brussels, and each item must weigh 30kg or less.
Additional bags From £35*, max measurements: L: 85cm x H: 85cm x W: 36cm.
*Guide price based on a one-way journey from London to Paris and requested more than 48 hours before departure.
For Eurostar's routes within Belgium, France, the Netherlands and Germany, you don't need to pre-book; simply turn up on the day, pay €30 per extra item, and you're good to go.
Please note, failure to comply will result in a charge of €30 per item or the item may not be permitted on board the train.
Pushchairs and prams are allowed free of charge – just make sure they're folded before you board and stored in the luggage rack.
Note that skis and snowboards can be counted as one of your two pieces of luggage.
Bikes (disassembled) From £45*, max measurements: L: 165cm x H: 90cm x W: 36cm.

compagnie.peso: Not stated; you must carry all your luggage in one go alone
compagnie.extra: Excess or non-compliant luggage: €50 for 1 item, €100 for 2, €150 for 3 or more
compagnie.speciali: Bikes, instruments, snowboards and skis in a labelled cover; one pair of skis per person
compagnie.risposta: on TGV INOUI you can take 2 suitcases and 1 item of hand luggage, or 1 suitcase, 1 special item and 1 item of hand luggage; a suitcase can measure up to 70 x 90 x 50 cm and hand luggage up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm, every bag must be labelled, and excess or non-compliant luggage can cost €50, €100 or €150.

citazioni.x: You must be able to carry all your luggage in one go alone.
You can take either: 2 suitcases + 1 item of hand luggage 1 suitcase + 1 special item of luggage + 1 item of hand luggage

Your hand luggage can measure a maximum of 40 cm x 30 cm x 15 cm Your suitcase can measure a maximum of 70 cm x 90 cm x 50 cm Your special item of luggage (musical instrument, covered bike, folded bike, scooter and folding wheelchair) can measure a maximum of 90 x 130 x 50 cm.

Failure to comply with the luggage policy on board TGV INOUI and INTERCITÉS trains may result in the payment of €50 for 1 item of excess or non-compliant luggage, €100 for 2 items of excess or non-compliant luggage, and €150 for 3 or more items of excess or non-compliant luggage.
Bikes, musical instruments, snowboards and skis must be in a labelled cover.
You can travel with your own pair of skis (no maximum dimensions), up to a maximum of one pair per person.
From 13 December 2026, scooters with a seat, those with more than two wheels, those that do not fold or those with a tire width greater than 6 cm will be prohibited on board.
All your luggage must be labelled and is your responsibility.
These on-board luggage rules also apply to TGV INOUI trains to and from Luxembourg, Spain, Brussels and Freiburg im Breisgau, to and from Italy.

For your TGV INOUI and ICE journeys with DB SNCF Voyageurs en coopération You must be able to carry all your luggage yourself without assistance. The maximum dimensions of 130 x 90 cm per item of luggage must be respected.

compagnie.numero: One item of hand luggage + one cabin bag included

One hand luggage item, measuring up to 40 × 30 × 15 cm. One cabin bag, up to 55 × 35 × 25 cm. These bags are stored under your seat.
The extra or oversized bag, up to 90 × 130 × 50 cm and 30 kg, costs €5 online.
It's also included in the OUIGO Plus and OUIGO Full packs.
If you don't book your baggage option online before departure, it will be charged at €20 at the station!
On a connecting journey, the extra or oversized baggage option must be added and paid for separately for each train on the route, on top of the train ticket.

Sports equipment (skis, snowboard, skateboard, other boards): they travel under the extra baggage option. They must be stored in a cover and respect the dimensions 90 × 130 × 50 cm; skis are accepted in a cover up to 2 m.
Pushchair: for families, it's free if you're travelling with your child.
Bikes and scooters have their own dedicated option, separate from extra baggage.
A useful habit before you leave: label all your bags with your name.

The maximum dimensions allowed are 85x55x35 cm. (height-width-depth).
Please bear in mind that the luggage policy is stricter on Avlo trains.
Please note that you can only carry one special piece of luggage per person on board, accompanied by another piece of hand luggage, with maximum dimensions 55x35x25.

All bicycles and scooters folded in a cover are considered hand luggage as long as their dimensions do not add up to more than 180 cm between the three elements, and therefore will be accepted free of charge on all regular Renfe Viajeros (Renfe Passengers) services.

All folded or dismantled kick scooters (non-electric) and bicycles, placed inside a carrying case or bag whose total dimensions (length-height-width) amount to more than 180 cm, up to a maximum of 140x90x40 cm. (length-height-width).
Golf clubs, ski and sports fishing equipment must be carried in their corresponding bags and perfectly closed.
Musical instruments, carried in their case, may not be bigger than 30 x 120 x 38 cm.
If travelling on the AVE (high-speed) International high-speed train between Spain and France, the same terms and conditions apply to hand luggage, except that luggage tagging is mandatory.

Luggage may be permitted to exceed this volume limit as long as it does not disturb or cause injury to other passengers, does not obstruct railway staff from carrying out their work, and does not damage the coach.

citazioni.x: Yes, you can bring luggage on Italo trains for free. Passengers can carry as many items as needed, including large bags and foldable bicycles, thanks to designated storage areas at the end of each coach, overhead racks, and lockers in some coaches.
Luggage with dimensions up to 75 x 53 x 30 is allowed in Smart Class, with no additional costs, making it convenient for travelers with multiple items.
Compared to other means of transport, Italo allows to accommodate even large luggage in Prima Business and Club Executive classes, which is advantageous for those with bulky suitcases.
Please note that these compartments have a maximum height of 53 cm and a depth of 42 cm.
Traveling on Italo trains with strollers, folding bicycles, and scooters (both electric and manual) is permitted, as long as they are fully folded and stored in the designated areas.
Transporting oversized luggage, bulky items, or traditional bicycles is not allowed.

You do not need to make a reservation for your luggage, and you do not need to weigh or measure your bags before you travel.
The following standard dimensions were assumed when dimensioning the luggage racks and almost always fit: 700 x 500 x 300 mm (height x width x depth).

Folding bicycles, folding pedelecs and small electric vehicles (e.g. electric scooters, tread scooters, kickboards, etc.) may be carried when folded, provided they can be stowed safely (e.g. in the luggage rack) and do not obstruct or injure other passengers, or damage the carriage.
You will need a long-distance transport bicycle ticket and a storage space reservation.
The information provided here is applicable to long-distance trains operated by Deutsche Bahn.

compagnie.treni: ÖBB trains in Austria, including Railjet, and ÖBB Nightjet night trains
compagnie.chi: ÖBB’s fare rules for travel in Austria
compagnie.numero: No fixed number; free if it fits the racks
compagnie.misure: Each piece up to 90 cm x 60 cm x 40 cm
compagnie.extra: No fee; luggage that blocks passageways or doors can be removed from the train
compagnie.speciali: Skis, snowboards, instruments, pushchairs and folded bikes free even if larger; folded bikes up to 110 cm x 80 cm x 40 cm on Railjet

citazioni.x: You can carry along luggage free of charge on our trains, provided that it is stowed in the luggage racks above or below your seat or in the areas provided for hand luggage. The pieces of luggage must not exceed the maximum dimensions of 90 cm x 60 cm x 40 cm.

If pieces of luggage are too large or if there are too many pieces of luggage, so that passageways, doors, escape routes or safety installations are blocked, thereby endangering the safety of all passengers, we must have them removed from the train.

The following pieces of luggage can also be carried along free of charge if the dimensions specified in Section A.4.1.1.1. are exceeded: Skis & snowboards Ski and hiking poles Wind, string or plucked instruments Wheelchairs Strollers Collapsed folding bicycles Scooters and e-Scooters

We transport collapsed folding bicycles and scooters with a maximum dimension of 110 cm x 80 cm x 40 cm free of charge in the multi-purpose compartments of local trains as well as in the marked luggage racks of ÖBB long-distance trains in the Railjet and Railjet Express train categories.
Please stow easy-to-stow luggage using the luggage racks above the seats. As their height is limited, please stow bulky luggage under your seat or in suitable luggage racks, if available.
Bicycles can currently only be taken on Nightjets travelling between Germany and Austria, as well as Switzerland (seasonal). Bicycles require separate tickets and reservations.

It is not possible to bring extra luggage for a fee.
You can usually take your luggage with you on international trains free of charge.

citazioni.x: When travelling to and from London, there are passport and luggage checks before you board the train. The timings below are just for guidance and can sometimes change. Download your ticket to check the most up-to-date recommended arrival time.
Please arrive at the recommended time and not just before the ticket gates close.
There may be times when you experience queues at the station. This can particularly happen on peak days or when checks take a bit longer.

When travelling on our trains (except to and from London), just look for your train on the departure board and head straight to the platform. For stress-free boarding, we’d recommend arriving at the station 20 minutes before your scheduled departure time. Be ready to board at least 5 minutes before departure (10 minutes when travelling from Paris Gare du Nord).
To access the platforms at Amsterdam Centraal or Rotterdam Centraal, you’ll need to scan your ticket’s QR code at the station’s ticket gates.
From 12 October 2025, we're gradually introducing the EU's new Entry/Exit System (EES) border procedures.
The EU’s Entry/Exit System (EES) is a new border requirement for non-EU nationals (including British nationals). It impacts Eurostar journeys to/from London.
It’s being gradually rolled out from 12 October 2025.

EES isn’t like a travel authorisation or visa – it's completely free and you don’t need to apply for anything ahead of your journey. It all happens at border control at your departure station on the day of travel.

Just arrive at the station at the recommended time stated on your ticket. This timing takes into account how much time you’ll need for all pre-departure checks (ticket, security and border checks). We’ve also allowed for any EES steps you may have to complete at border control, which may include registering your biometrics (face image and fingerprints).

Travelling in Eurostar Premier or as a Carte Blanche or Étoile Club Eurostar member from London St Pancras International? When you get to Eurostar Departures to start your journey, you may be invited by our station team to register with EES using a pre-registration kiosk. These are located opposite the Eurostar Premier priority ticket gates.
Eurostar Premier priority ticket gates close 15 minutes before departure, but please make sure you arrive at departures with plenty of time to spare.

In time, all non-EU nationals required to register for EES (including British nationals) will need to do so every time they enter or leave the EU - so, every time they travel to or from London with Eurostar.

eurostar.nota_ees: Eurostar’s help page on EES still describes the first months of the roll-out; the European Commission says EES became fully operational on 10 April 2026 (quoted below).
